description: This Scala source file defines an object for managing pipeline-specific table properties in Apache Spark, including validation, registration, and property access mechanisms.

classes.name: PipelineTableProperty
classes.description: Represents a pipeline table property with key, default value, and parsing logic.

methods.name: validateAndCanonicalize
methods.description: Validates and canonicalizes raw pipeline table properties, warning on unknown or suspicious properties.

methods.name: buildProp
methods.description: Registers a new pipeline table property with a specified key and default value.

methods.name: fromMap
methods.description: Extracts and parses the property value from a map of raw properties.

methods.name: parseFromString
methods.description: Parses a string value into the property type, throwing an exception if parsing fails.
